prompt:
Our column renderer needs to shorten long identifiers while keeping both ends visible.

Add `truncate_middle(text, width)` to `textfmt.py`. It should keep the start and the end of the text and put `...` in the middle. Always keep at least 3 characters from the start and at least 3 characters from the end, so identifiers stay recognisable. When the text is cut, split the remaining space as evenly as possible, giving any odd extra character to the start. Text that already fits is returned unchanged. Add tests and mention the function in the README.

Make the change in this repository.
